systems.platform: digital civil registration platform integrated with the national identity commission, primary health centres and 'Local Government Wards'
systems.tiers: operational in 36 states, with ward registrars in 15; 3,372 wards activated, about 7,000 planned before the end of 2027; 1,982 health facilities integrated; 304 registration workstations deployed; civil registration offices in wards and local government areas, where an 'NPC/LGA functionary' certifies the birth

note: The Registrar General's presentation of 18 July 2026 gives the digital civil registration system's reach by ward (3,372 activated), health facility (1,982) and workstation (304), and says an 'NPC/LGA functionary' certifies births at civil registration offices in wards and local government areas. It does not say a local government's own office is connected or that its staff work in the system, and gives no count of local governments; it adds that offline working is essential where connectivity is low. Read as the national commission's field structure, so no fact; the parent may weigh the 'NPC/LGA functionary' wording.
